meta.method: Transcripts have no speaker labels; answers were separated from the interviewer’s fixed question guide and coded by hand. All quotes are verbatim and machine-verified against the transcript.
meta.caveat: Only 3 interviews — qualitative evidence for patterns and wording, not for percentages. One call (V1) had poor audio.
